thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: route=chat-completions/model-group-B p99 latency 2.3s > threshold 1.8s at 10:07 UTC
oncall_alex: Seeing elevated p95/p99 on B group, brief spike across us-west-2. Investigating autoscaler and kv-cache hit rate.
sre_maya: I have a view up. Looks correlated with several large prompts (long seq). KV cache miss rate jumped to 27%.
platform_jordan: Scaling events look normal, but one host in pool returned high steal time. Might be noisy neighbor on the node.
oncall_alex: Mitigation idea: temporarily widen p99 threshold for model-group-B to 2.5s and enable aggressive per-route concurrency cap to reduce queuing. Any objections?
product_liam: Customer-impact check: top 5 customers by volume—no errors, just higher latency. Not seeing SLO breaches yet in billing tier.
se_ops: Can we route some low-priority traffic to model-group-A (faster but slightly lower quality) for 10 mins as fallback?
eng_olly: We have fallback route configured but rollout needs manual switch. I can flip a routing policy canary to 20% now.
sre_maya: +1 to routing canary + widen threshold. Also recommend adding a temporary alert suppression on noisy host ID i-0a12 to stop duplicate paging.
oncall_alex: Doing plan: 1) widen p99 -> 2.5s for model-group-B, 2) set per-route concurrency cap 50, 3) roll canary 20% to model-group-A, 4) suppress host i-0a12 alerts. Executing now.
incident-bot: Action logged by oncall_alex: changed alert threshold for alert_id=latency-p99-b to 2.5s, applied suppression for host i-0a12 (30m).
platform_jordan: Concurrency cap applied. Can confirm queues reduced on busiest instances.
eng_olly: Canary at 20% done — traffic shifting. No immediate customer complaints.
se_ops: Monitoring top-customer latencies now. Peeking dashboards.
sre_maya: p99 dropped to 1.9s within 2 minutes of actions. KV cache miss still elevated but falling to 15%.
product_liam: Logging this as a potential regression in the last deploy from yesterday? Any deploys touching embeddings cache or routing?
platform_jordan: No deploys in the last 6h. Host noisy neighbor seems likely. We'll mark as infra incident temporarily.
oncall_alex: After-action asks: we should (A) add a per-model/per-route p95/p99 baseline dashboard, (B) consider adaptive thresholds that widen automatically for known long-seq workloads, (C) add host-level dedupe to alerting.
sre_maya: Agree. Also propose a short-lived mitigation runbook: sequence-detection -> auto-widen threshold -> route canary -> suppress per-host duplicates.
se_ops: I can add the customer impact notes and notify CS for customers above 99th percentile latency.
product_liam: Note: consider adding a flag in the config to prefer model-group-A for low-priority system messages.
eng_olly: I'll open a small PR for the routing canary automation and a dashboard tile for per-route p95/p99.
platform_jordan: For alert tuning: recommend per-route thresholds instead of global, and add hysteresis (require 2 consecutive windows).
oncall_alex: Sounds good. I'll create a post-incident ticket with tasks: alert-per-route baselines, dedupe logic, adaptive widen feature, dashboard tiles, runbook doc. Assigning owners in thread.
incident-bot: Postmortem ticket created: INC-280999-A: "latency thrash -> routing canary & threshold widen" assigned to oncall_alex, due 3 days.
product_liam: Thanks team. Keep me posted if any customers escalate.
se_ops: No escalations yet. I'll ping CS if that changes.
sre_maya: Closing mitigation — rolling back suppression in 5m and keeping canary at 10% for 30m to observe.
oncall_alex: Thanks all. We'll follow up with a dashboard PR and alert tuning RFC. :thumbsup:
